# Open Sans Bold

Open Sans Bold, version 1.10, from the local Satisfactory editor asset
`/Game/FactoryGame/Interface/Font/OpenSans-Bold`. The embedded TrueType data was
exported without changing its design. Digitized data copyright 2010–2011 Google
Corporation. Distributed under Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.txt.

TeleportLogistics's identification plates use planar outlines of this font, with no raised
or emissive lettering. Blender's default Bfont is no longer used for the plates.
